definitions.gloss: to be bulky; to take up space
definitions.explanation: to occupy a large amount of space relative to weight or quantity

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嵩張|かさば}る。
⟦{冬服|ふゆふく}→冬服：23084_fuyufuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嵩張|かさば}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: Winter clothes are bulky, so storage is a problem.

examples.japanese: {嵩張|かさば}らない⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a souvenir that doesn't take up much space.

notes:
{嵩張|かさば}る describes things that take up a lot of space relative to their content or value.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (る-verb with ら-row conjugation)
- Intransitive

WRITING:
- {嵩|かさ} means "bulk, volume"
- {張|ば}る means "to stretch, extend"
- Often written in hiragana: かさばる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{嵩張|かさば}る (luggage is bulky)
- {嵩張|かさば}らない (not bulky, compact)
- ⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵩張|かさば}る (bulky for storage)

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- Winter clothes, bedding
- Packaging, boxes
- Luggage, bags
- Gifts and souvenirs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take up space - more general)
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (big - simple size)
- かさむ (to pile up - amount/cost)

USAGE:
- Implies inconvenience due to size
- Often used when something is large but light
- Negative connotation in most contexts

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
